name: Station battery incoming isolation boundary
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Marks the assigned isolation connection between the battery and its DC distribution system.
description: Marks the assigned isolation connection between the battery and its DC distribution system. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Battery output connection” at the input and “Defined battery incoming boundary” at the output. Battery terminals can remain energized independently.

Battery capacity, DC fault duty, charging settings and ventilation require the selected battery-system design; illustrative circuits do not establish autonomy.
